shots.name: 01-kaleidoscope
shots.title: A Kaleidoscope You Can Touch
shots.sub: Push, pinch, twist, tilt and shake
shots.alt: A six-petal flower pattern in magenta, blue and yellow, mirrored six ways over a deep indigo background.

shots.name: 02-mirror
shots.title: Mirror It Up to 12 Ways
shots.alt: A dashed star pattern in yellow, orange and pink, mirrored four ways with gaps between the copies, on dark purple.

shots.name: 03-beads
shots.title: Beads That Bounce and Roll
shots.alt: Beads shaped like circles, stars and hearts in bright colors, gathered around a gravity well over a blue spiral.

shots.name: 04-targets
shots.title: Pick What Your Fingers Move
shots.alt: Five gesture targets fanned out from the bottom button over a spiral: Pattern, Crop, Particles, Mirror and Gravity.

shots.name: 05-colors
shots.title: Colors That Blend and Cycle
shots.sub: Pick a list, run it either way
shots.alt: The color controls open over a spiral: the foreground and background color lists, a swatch palette and cycle speeds.

shots.name: 06-audio
shots.title: Let It Move to the Music
shots.sub: Turn on Audio Reactive in Settings
shots.alt: The Settings sheet: Audio Reactive with Mic Sensitivity, Haptics, Sound, Shake to Randomize and the Auto-Hide Delay.
